note: PROFESSIONAL TAX AS PER GOVERNMENT RULES, by the state of the employee's branch (or their own PT state). Monthly slabs on monthly gross, FY 2026-27 (Constitution Art. 276, Rs 2,500/year cap). Kept in step with the 'Statutory reference' table on the Salary structure screen. Change the law here, not in PHP. These are the shipped Government defaults: Organization Setup -> PT Slabs shows them and, once saved there, the tenant's own rules are used instead. Every state and UT is listed (owner, 29 Oct 2026: "keep as per government rules if state is not mentioned"); a state still not covered is refused at payroll rather than taxed at zero.
annual_cap_note: Constitution Article 276(2): no person pays more than Rs 2,500 a year in profession tax. Shown as the annual maximum on Organization Setup -> PT Slabs, where each rule's year total is checked against it.
pwd_note: The Employee field that records a person with disability, and the answer that means yes — used by a PT rule's 'Exempt persons with disability' (Organization Setup -> PT Slabs).
state_names: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu

tamil nadu.note: Half-yearly on half-year income; deducted in the last month of each half (September, March) on monthly gross x 6.

kerala.note: Kerala Municipality Act 1994 / Kerala Panchayat Raj Act 1994; rates revised by G.O. No. 1149/2024/LSGD from 01-10-2024. Half-yearly on half-year income (Apr-Sep, Oct-Mar), due 31 Aug and end of Feb.

madhya pradesh.note: MP Vritti Kar Adhiniyam 1995, Schedule (salary and wage earners): yearly income bands, deducted monthly; the 12th month (March) carries the balance so the year totals Rs 1,500 / 2,000 / 2,500.

assam.note: Assam Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Taxation Act, 1947; schedule w.e.f. 15-10-2014. Monthly salary. CA to confirm.

bihar.note: Bihar Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 2011: yearly income bands (nil to Rs 3,00,000; Rs 1,000; Rs 2,000; Rs 2,500), deducted monthly with the balance in March. CA to confirm.

jharkhand.note: Jharkhand Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 2011: yearly income bands (nil to Rs 3,00,000; Rs 1,200; Rs 1,800; Rs 2,100; Rs 2,500), deducted monthly, balance in March. CA to confirm.

manipur.note: Manipur Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Taxation (Eighth Amendment) Act, 2012: yearly income, paid once a year by 30 September. CA to confirm (Ninth Amendment 2020 not checked).

meghalaya.note: Meghalaya Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Taxation Act (as amended 2022): monthly salary. CA to confirm against the notification.

mizoram.note: Mizoram Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Taxation Act, 1995; notification J.17011/1/2017-TAX dated 11-07-2024. Monthly salary. CA to confirm.

nagaland.note: Nagaland Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Taxation (Fourth Amendment) Act, 2012. Monthly salary. CA to confirm.

puducherry.note: Puducherry Municipalities Act, 1973, ss. 144-151, Schedule IV (Act 5 of 2017): half-yearly income, deducted in September and March. CA to confirm.

sikkim.note: Sikkim Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 2006. Monthly salary. CA to confirm.

tripura.note: Tripura Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Taxation Act, 1997 (rates by notification). Monthly salary. CA to confirm against the current notification.

odisha.note: Odisha State Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 2000 repealed (Ordinance, 21-04-2026). CA to confirm.
